answer:
The parameter is `context_window`, set on `Settings`. The settings guide describes it as the "maximum input size to the LLM": "# maximum input size to the LLM" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/supporting_modules/settings.md]. The example sets it as "Settings.context_window = 4096" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/supporting_modules/settings.md].

The older `max_input_size` name has been replaced: "The `max_input_size` parameter for the prompt helper has since been replaced with `context_window`." [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/changes/deprecated_terms.md]
